title: Kitne Door Kitne Paas
desc: After studying in New York City, Jatin (Fardeen Khan) is returning home to India, where he's set to marry a woman from his hometown. On his flight to Delhi, he meets Karishma (Amrita Arora), coincidentally on her way to her own marriage, and her quick temper instantly sets them at odds. Once in Delhi, the unlikely travel companions find their connecting flight has been cancelled, so Jatin and Karishma must share a long bus ride to Gujarat, discovering each other and themselves in the process.

title: Ragini Mms 2
desc: A director attempts to shoot an erotic horror movie in a house where, unbeknown to him, a demonic spirit resides. Even before the crew starts filming, the spirit possesses the lead actress's body.

title: Baghban
desc: It tells the story of Raj and Pooja, a couple married for 40 years, who are forced to live apart after retirement when their four sons refuse to care for them together.

title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.
